message: 幸のとなり

name: Misa
message: 「Hurry, hurry, hurry, hurry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hustle, hustle, hustle, hustle!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't run, you two! At least in the morning, take your time and walk to school leisurely」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not running. While competing with Sakura-kun, I just started walking a little faster than usual.」

name: Synn
message: 「Speaking of Lolotte, according to the encyclopedia, racewalking is--」

name: Misa
message: 「I keep telling you it's not racewalking!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Geez, doing something like this on a school route with so many hills」

name: Paqy
message: 「Say what you will, Soba's pretty dutiful for tagging along with this too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Goal」

name: Misa
message: 「Grrr!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Well?!」
I pass through the school gate in first place, with Misa and Nanaka following almost simultaneously right behind.

name: Misa
message: 「I-I lost again」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though I want to score a total victory over Sakura-kun and enjoy a fun school life!」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't mean to beat you, Misa? I'm just walking normally. Huff, puff, huff, puff.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heaving your shoulders like that, how is that normal?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn, if you're gonna do this every morning, wouldn't it be better to just lose on purpose?」

name: Synn
message: 「That would be against the rules.」

name: Misa
message: 「I'd definitely hate that... hey, don't agree with me!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, I can't tell if you two get along well or not.」

name: Misa
message: 「We do not!」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't get so worked up, Misa. Hydrate and calm down. Here, it's the second-place prize, Milky Milk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「I don't want it! Don't get full of yourself just because you came in first!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh yeah? Then I'll go ahead and enjoy my first-place Milky Milk first. Gulp, gulp...」

name: Synn
message: 「Delicious!」

name: Synn
message: 「And for Nanaka, here's the third-place Milky Milk.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I don't want it! More importantly, Synn, I came in second, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, yes~♪ Leave it to me at times like this. Record-keeper Jeeves, bring out the burst photos for the judgment!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「L-Lolotte, you're relying on someone else the very second you say that?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave assisting Milady with the judging to me, your humble butler, Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Here are the photographs.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hmm, hmm... The winner is the President. As for the silver medal...」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Isn't this a tie?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Bzzzt, wrong. Look closely--the Vice President's boobs crossed the finish line first.」

name: Misa
message: 「B-Boobs...!?」

name: Misa
message: 「From what angle are you taking pictures of what, Riesling-san?!」

name: Riesling
message: 「I am deeply humbled.」

name: Misa
message: 「That wasn't a compliment!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The difference between the Vice President's and the Treasurer's boobs is a mere two centimeters, yet... Commentator Amyrina, how do you analyze this fact?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Huh? Y-Yes, um... Two centimeters is twenty million nanometers.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't go out of your way to convert it into units like that!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「E-Eeeek! I-I-I'm sorry!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「B-But, um... Even without fussing over winning or losing or who ranks higher, aren't you all plenty happy already?」

name: Misa
message: 「No! Until I stand above Sakura-kun, there is no happiness for me! We're having another match tomorrow!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp, gulp, gulp!」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen to me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「B-But you and Nanaka both said you didn't want any milk, Misa. It'd be a waste, so I have to drink all three bottles」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, Misa, happiness doesn't have a top or bottom. Look, try writing the character '幸' upside down」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa, it's still 'happiness' no matter which way you look at it. That's actually kinda amazing」

name: Riesling
message: 「That is the warning bell. Though it pains me to part with you, My Lady, we must bid each other farewell until after school」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, I'll be off then」

name: Misa
message: 「'Privatization of dried bonito'... 'Did you eat squid'... No, I can't win with things like this!」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Those are palindromes」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're so smart, Misa. I couldn't even come up with anything like that」

name: Lolotte
message: 「'Dad, want some papaya?' 'Papa, nah'」

name: Amyrina
message: 「Lolotte, that's completely off the mark...」
